title: Starter Flow Spotlight: progressive checklist, empty-state scaffolds, and contextual tips
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and deliver a set of UI assets, screenshot templates, and microcopy variations for the Console first-run experience. Deliverables should enable engineering and content to ship an interactive progressive checklist (starter flow), multiple empty-state scaffolds, and 3 contextual tip variants that can be A/B tested. Focus areas: accessibility contrast, localization-ready copy, lightweight micro-animations for progress transitions, and clear call-to-action states for both new orgs and returning users with empty resources.
acceptance_criteria: Progressive checklist UI designed at 1024px/1366px/1920px breakpoints with componentized Figma frames
Empty-state scaffolds (no projects, no models, no keys) each with 2 visual variants and copy variants for technical and non-technical audiences
Three contextual tip templates: inline tooltip row, modal deep-dive, and subtle banner; each with copy, CTA, and recommended timing/event rules
Accessible color tokens and contrast checks documented (WCAG AA minimum) for all assets
Localization-ready strings exported as CSV; microcopy approved by PM and Localization lead
Handoff package: Figma file, PNG/JPEG screenshot exports (3 sizes), developer tokens, and a small usage spec document
Design QA signoff and a linked E2E test checklist for engineering
mockup_notes: Primary breakpoint targets: 1024w (tablet), 1366w (laptop), 1920w (desktop). Use fixed 24px margins at 1366w reference.
Checklist component should support progressive reveal: step items collapsed -> expand with 160ms ease-out micro-animation and subtle elevation change.
Empty-state scaffolds include: illustration slot (SVG), quick action button (primary), secondary text line, and keyboard shortcut hint where applicable.
Screenshot templates: produce 3 variations per state — clean (no annotations), annotated (callouts for CTA), and annotated-plus (step-by-step overlay). Export @1x, @2x PNGs.
Tooltips: keep to 1–2 short sentences (max 140 characters) and a single CTA. Provide long-form help copy in modal variant for users who need more context.
Localization notes: avoid colloquialisms; reserve space for languages that expand by up to +30% length (e.g., DE, FR). Use flexible button widths.
Accessibility: ensure focus states for checklist items and keyboard nav order. Provide ARIA labels and role suggestions in handoff doc.
A/B variants: Variant A emphasizes speed ("Get started in 5 minutes"), Variant B emphasizes safety/compliance ("Secure by default — learn more").
